title: MPE-seq Protocol
author: Ben Fair
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zpaf5ie
materials: Induce fragmentation by heating in thermocycler at 65°C for 15 minutes. *(Different RNA samples may need optimization). In past, I have ran a time-course I and decided to use a fragmentation time about half-way between when the rRNA bands start to become indescernable (under fragmented) and saturating (over-fragmented).

Program the following thermocylcer program, preferably on a cycler that can hold temperature during a user-pause 70°C 1min 65°C 5min 55°C 5min (Optional user pause to hold at 55°C) 55°C 30min 80°C 10min 25°C hold

Once reaction hits 55°C or during user pause, preheat the enzyme mix by placing on thermocycler for a few minutes. Once reaction is preheated, can mix 20uL enzyme mix directly to primer/template mix. *Not preheating enzyme leads to substantial increase of off-target primer-extensions.
Quantify by NanoDrop. Store at -20°C or continue.

Test PCR: Best to do a test PCR with a small amount of template to verify that it works before using up all of the template! Use NEB 2X HiFi MM with 2uL template Perform the following qPCR cycling: Denaturation: 95 °C 3 min Amplification (40x): 98 °C 10 sec 62 °C 20 sec 72 °C 30 sec Final elongation: 72 °C 5 min I typically get Ct values around ~20. The best way to be sure the protocol worked is to look at the qPCR product on a gel, compared to a no template control.

steps.title: Optional RNA Fragmentation
steps.instruction: Fragment 15 to 40ug of RNA if necessary to eliminate size biases.

substeps.instruction: Assemble the following reaction in a PCR tube for each sample: 20-40ug RNA, 2uL Fragmentation buffer, and DEPC Water up to 20uL total.
Add fragmentation buffer last and keep reactions on ice during setup.
Stop fragmentation by adding 2uL fragmentation STOP buffer and placing samples on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Primer/Template Mix
steps.instruction: Create a primer/template mix for each sample in a PCR tube and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Combine 4uL 5X RT buffer, 2uL 1ststrand primer pool, 10ug Total RNA, and DEPC Water up to 20uL total.

steps.title: Prepare Enzyme Mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare an enzyme mastermix at 21uL per sample in a single PCR tube (split into multiple tubes if volume exceeds 100uL).

substeps.instruction: Combine 4uL 5X RT buffer, 4uL DTT, 2uL dNTP mix, 4uL water, 4uL Biotin dUTP, and 2uL SSIV (Total 20uL).

steps.title: First Strand Synthesis
steps.instruction: Denature, anneal, and extend the first strand using a thermocycler.

substeps.instruction: Add primer mix/template to the thermocycler to denature and anneal primers (70°C to 65°C to 55°C).
Proceed with reaction at 55°C for 30min.
Inactivate the enzyme at 80°C.

steps.title: RNA Degradation and Neutralization
steps.instruction: Degrade the RNA template via base hydrolysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 20uL RNA hydrolysis solution and incubate at 65°C for 15min.
Add 20uL neutralization solution (final sample volume 80uL).

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform ethanol precipitation to exchange the buffer.

substeps.instruction: Bring sample volume to 50uL by adding 26uL water and transfer to a 1.5mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 5uL (1/10 sample volume) 3M sodium acetate, followed by 137.5uL (2.5 sample volumes) 100% ethanol.
Vortex and cool to encourage precipitation (2+ hours at -20°C or 15min at -80°C).
Centrifuge at max-speed in a cold centrifuge for 10min to pellet; aspirate liquid.
Wash pellet twice with 200uL (full sample volume) of 80% ethanol, aspirating liquid after each wash.
Aspirate and air-dry the pellet on the benchtop.
Resuspend pellet in water to a concentration of ~2ug/uL.

steps.title: First AMPure Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean the sample using AMPureXP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8 sample volumes of AMPureXP beads.
Capture beads on a magnetic stand for 2min and aspirate liquid.
Wash twice with 200uL 70% ethanol (incubate 30 seconds on stand per wash) and aspirate.
Remove from stand and elute with 50uL water by pipetting thoroughly.
Place on magnetic stand for 2min and transfer supernate to a labeled 1.5mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Biotin-Bead Purification (First Round)
steps.instruction: Purify the biotinylated strands using specialized beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare beads: Vortex beads, transfer 20uL per sample to a 1.5mL tube, incubate on magnetic stand for 1min, and aspirate buffer.
Wash beads twice with 500uL 1x bind and wash buffer (1min on stand per wash), then aspirate.
Resuspend beads in 50uL 2x bind and wash buffer per sample and aliquot into PCR tubes.
Bind: Add 50uL prepared beads to 50uL sample; agitate on rotator at RT for 30min.
Incubate on magnetic stand for 1min and aspirate buffer.
Wash: Wash 3 times with 150uL 1x bind and wash buffer (1min on stand per wash), then aspirate.
SSC Wash: Wash with 100uL 1x SSC (1min on stand), then aspirate.
Denature: Add 100uL denaturing solution, incubate 10min at RT, incubate on stand for 1min, and aspirate.
Denature Wash: Wash with 100uL denaturing solution (1min on stand), then aspirate.
TE Wash: Wash 3 times with 100uL TE buffer (1min on stand per wash), then aspirate.
Elute: Add 50uL bead elution buffer, incubate at 90°C for 2min, incubate on stand for 1min, and transfer supernate to a new tube.

steps.title: Second AMPure Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean the eluted sample using AMPureXP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8 sample volumes of AMPureXP beads.
Capture beads on magnetic stand for 2min and aspirate liquid.
Wash twice with 200uL 70% ethanol (30 seconds on stand per wash) and aspirate.
Elute with 40uL water by pipetting thoroughly.
Place on magnetic stand for 2min and transfer supernate to a labeled 1.5mL centrifuge tube; store at -20°C or continue.

steps.title: Second Strand Extension
steps.instruction: Extend the second strand using Klenow exo- enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction mix per sample: 5uL 10X NEB Buffer 2, 1uL 10mM dNTP Mix, 40uL cDNA from previous step, and 1uL 1stStrand Extension Primer (Total 47uL).
Incubate at 65°C for 2min.
Cool to RT on benchtop for ~5min.
Add 3uL Klenow exo- enzyme.
Incubate at RT for 5min.
Incubate at 37°C for 30min.

steps.title: Biotin-Bead Purification (Second Round)
steps.instruction: Repeat the biotin-bead purification process for the second strand products.

substeps.instruction: Prepare beads: Vortex, transfer 20uL per sample to 1.5mL tube, incubate on stand 1min, aspirate buffer.
Wash beads twice with 500uL 1x bind and wash buffer (1min on stand per wash), then aspirate.
Resuspend beads in 50uL 2x bind and wash buffer per sample and aliquot into PCR tubes.
Bind: Add 50uL prepared beads to 50uL sample; agitate on rotator at RT for 30min.
Incubate on magnetic stand for 1min and aspirate buffer.
Wash: Wash 3 times with 150uL 1x bind and wash buffer (1min on stand per wash), then aspirate.
SSC Wash: Wash with 100uL 1x SSC (1min on stand), then aspirate.
Denature: Add 100uL denaturing solution, incubate 10min at RT, incubate on stand for 1min, and aspirate.
Denature Wash: Wash with 100uL denaturing solution (1min on stand), then aspirate.
TE Wash: Wash 3 times with 100uL TE buffer (1min on stand per wash), then aspirate.
Elute: Add 50uL bead elution buffer, incubate at 90°C for 2min, incubate on stand for 1min, and transfer supernate to a new tube.

steps.title: Final AMPure Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a final cleanup of the purified product.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.8 sample volumes of AMPureXP beads.
Capture beads on magnetic stand for 2min and aspirate liquid.
Wash twice with 200uL 70% ethanol (30 seconds on stand per wash) and aspirate.
Elute with 20uL water by pipetting thoroughly.
Place on magnetic stand for 2min and transfer supernate to a labeled 1.5mL centrifuge tube; store at -20°C or continue.
Perform PCR using all remaining template in a 40uL reaction for the necessary number of cycles to achieve amplification.
Clean the PCR product with AMPure beads.
Sequence the library (suggested 1-5 million reads).
